subject.title: feat(durable): add opt-in workflow worker loop

question: Should the durable worker loop be deferred, or which approved core or plugin owner should register production step handlers into the gateway registry?
rationale: The safety repair correctly prevents empty-registry claims, but the real gateway has no handler owner, so code review cannot choose the permanent execution boundary.

options.title: Defer the worker loop
options.body: Remove the gateway startup hook and worker tuning environment surfaces until a real production workflow owner exists.

options.title: Define handler ownership now
options.body: Add a narrow approved registration seam, production handlers, and exact-head gateway execution proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Defer the worker loop
recommendation.body: Remove the gateway startup hook and worker tuning environment surfaces until a real production workflow owner exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans both the gateway lifecycle and subagent runtime boundaries affected by this architectural choice.
